subject: Stupid People
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Last night was a great example. me and unreal were racing and then this guy starts blasting her off and me off because he wants to compare how much we get paid an hour. He said he was an engineer, 18yrs old, and makes 32.50 an hour.. So were like your point is what? Are you suppose to say that your better than us because you make more money? What da hell is that? Stupid kids dont realize that the real world dont care about how much money you make because people are too busy worrying about their own thing. Personally, I dont make what he makes an hour but I sure make up for it earning 40 on one and 22 on the other.... so whats the difference?

-----------------------------------

subject: Talking is Vital?
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
Talking isnt necessarily vital. Its cool if you just want to mess around but many competitive players dont even talk when the competition is sky high. Why? Because the focus is to win and talking can be a distraction. I like rooms that have competition, but I also like rooms that are sometimes quiet because having a quiet room does bring out the best in some racers.

 

Personally, it doesnt bother me whether you want to talk or not. There's too many people that dont say anything to begin with and prove that they are great racers on the field. I would much rather race those players than do race well rather than those that talk and dont race at all.

 

So here to ya, if you ever go into my room and I know you can race, it doesnt bother me if you have a mic or not. I wont kick you. I will kick people out who anchor other racers tho. And I truly kick them out with a passion because it isnt fair for those racers who are fast to be dealing with handicap either.
